claim: finite sensing structure bounds stable damped transient times under generalized evolutionary response

structural_layer.gap_ceiling: Delta_g <= min(m,F_b(n,h))-h, optionally intersected with productive-frontier edge cap E

generalized_phase.maximum_damping_rule: evaluate damping time at largest structurally allowed integer gap with a_g*g<G_plus
generalized_phase.maximum_period_rule: evaluate period at smallest structurally allowed integer gap with G_osc<a_g*g<G_plus

interpretation: Finite sensing constraints bound the integer generalized-gain ladder, but alpha and phi set the phase boundaries and transient geometry. The same sensing scope can therefore imply different time ceilings under different evolutionary responses.
prior_art_boundary: Integer-envelope optimization and local eigenvalue time formulas are standard; repository-specific input is the exact finite sensing gap ceiling and its mapping into generalized gain.
scope: local deterministic scalar generalized response, unit-cost finite sensing, restoring ecological feedback, continuous structural lift
